about_the_game:
Want to support the developers? The best way to do so is to purchase this guidebook!

Inside you will find:

  • "What is Echoes of G?": an explanation of what this side story is

  • Character data

  • Developer insights

  • A gallery of the game's artwork

  • 3 Bonus Wallpapers

This guidebook contains no spoilers and can be read before playing the game.

How to access the Supporter Pack after purchase:

  • Go to Tricks, Treats and Mirrors in your Steam Library

  • Right-click and select Manage>Browse Local Files

  • Select the folder titled "Supporter Pack"

  • Enjoy!
